item.title: Marblex Launches Pixel Tamers Web3 Mobile Game Globally
item.summary: Marblex, the blockchain-focused subsidiary of South Korean gaming company Netmarble, has launched Pixel Tamers, a Web3-enabled mobile game, globally as the company continues expanding its blockchain gaming portfolio. Developed by Returnpixel, Pixel Tamers is a pixel art-based idle role-playing game that combines monster collection, character development and deck-building mechanics.
